name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs and saves hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home-section drafts using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries. It does not yet render the saved sections.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager design and Abyss customization UI for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Renames the plugin display to Home Screen Manager, combines creation and management into one tab, removes the redundant generated-CSS section while retaining the native Jellyfin Branding save, removes the duplicate loading message, lets users change section types and reopen the correct editor, and migrates previous Abyss CSS markers safely. Test only; it does not yet render actual home-screen sections.
